reviews.review:
I took down a roadblock garrison, and NATO responded by sending 3 armed Blackfoot helicopters to my position within minutes.  And on top of that, CSAT just HAPPENED to have a jet overhead.  Of course, the jet took fire on my (unarmed) pickup truck rather than the 3 armed enemy helis in the same airspace.

Didn't matter though, the physics had already bugged out and flipped my truck over because I lost the lottery on which bushes actually have collision physics.

That said, 10/10.

Game is very good don't get me wrong, the story is a great way to sink your time into this game and have a good time with its realism, good jet and helicopter system or just overall fun with friends.

The reason I had to give this game a No is because it is just unplayable on most Multiplayer servers, most servers are pay to win or just get ruined by the constant ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ "You have been killed from more than 2000 meters from an AA turret" then having to spend time and in-game currency just to attempt to get back there.
  
The community on most servers are just awful too, I asked for some help while I was pinned and stuck in a building and I had no response from any of my teammates, i get that the game cant help this but it would be nice to have some good people to play with from time to time

Game is a solid purchase if you want to have fun on your own server with friends or just want to enjoy the awesome campaign, i'll consider changing this review if i'm happy with the game. 

8/10 for the campaign, helicopter and jet system and a 5/10 for the multiplayer servers.

суть геймплея в многопользовательских матчах с рандомами это бесконечно бежать на точку и(или) лететь не достигая её, то тебя танк раздавит, то ракета прилетит, то из снайпы убъют, в общем множество типов захватывающего геймплея, при том если собираешься играть один то я предлагаю тебе поиграть в ютуб шортс, есть ещё кампания но там меня постоянно пенетрируют поэтому мне не понравилось
